reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so two capsules already counted in one sachet for the evening is something I would actually use. $24.99 is an easy impulse buy for me, and the money-back if I finish the box takes the risk away.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month feels like a lot of packaging waste, and I am not totally sure about 'made in China' even with the lab report.
would_change_my_mind: If the sachets were recyclable or there was a refill option, I would feel better. If the price were over $35 for the first box, I would skip it.
